title: eventfd 8-byte counter
summary: An eventfd file descriptor holds a 64-bit counter. read(2) returns the counter (and resets it to 0 unless EFD_SEMAPHORE); write(2) adds to it; poll(2) signals readability when the counter is nonzero. The on-the-wire representation is just the 8-byte little-endian counter value.

ext.summary: An eventfd file descriptor holds a 64-bit counter. read(2) returns the counter (and resets it to 0 unless EFD_SEMAPHORE); write(2) adds to it; poll(2) signals readability when the counter is nonzero. The on-the-wire representation is just the 8-byte little-endian counter value.

structure.meaning: The counter value (little-endian). read returns this and resets to 0 (or decrements by 1 with EFD_SEMAPHORE). write adds the written value to the counter.

notes: eventfd is used as a lightweight event notification primitive (e.g. for io_uring, timerfd, signalfd integration).
EFD_SEMAPHORE makes read decrement by 1 instead of resetting (semaphore semantics).
The counter can overflow (EAGAIN on write if it would exceed UINT64_MAX - 1).
